messages:
sami_ml: FYI - onboarding proto48k-int4 with tile-compaction prefill shows reproducible token-shift after ~17.5k tokens. short repro and checks below.
tess_infra: paste serve flags + image tag? cluster?
sami_ml: `./serve --model proto48k-int4 --prefill=tile-compaction --prefill-tile=16 --prefill-stride=3 --kv=compact --quant=int4_regrow --compress-meta=true` image: gh/onboard/proto-int4:tile-try-7 cluster: ded-9
ugo_research: sample diff (fp16 vs int4):
```
FP16: "The panel convened on March 3, 2026, and unanimously approved the charter."
INT4: "The panel convened on March 3 2026 and approved unanimously the charter."
```
viktor_eval: that looks like punctuation drop + word reorder near long numeric spans. what are kv-checksums / rope-delta?
sami_ml: kv-checksum outputs: `fp16:0x9fa1b2c3`, `int4(compact):0xc4d2e1f0`, `int4(no-compact):0x9fa1b2c3`. rope-phase-diff (fp16 vs int4 compact): max delta=0.0034 rad at pos=17408
tess_infra: sounds like compact path reorders slot->logical_index mapping when stride!=1. run `kv-index-map --dump 17280..17440 --format=idx->slot` on both runs.
sami_ml: kv-index-map excerpt: `fp16: 17280->0x3a,17281->0x3b,...17440->0x4f` 
`int4(compact): 17280->0x39,17281->0x3b,...17440->0x4e`  <-- shift at tile boundary (17280)
ugo_research: pattern consistent with off-by-one when applying tile base offset during compaction. likely we multiply position by RoPE slope before remapping, rather than remap then apply slope. that would produce phase mismatch localized at boundaries.
viktor_eval: quick goldset (10 anchors) perp: fp16=9.1 int4(compact)=13.0 int4(no-compact)=9.3. so compact path is the culprit.
tess_infra: mitigation: flip `--prefill=tile-compaction` -> `--prefill=tile-linear` for canary and add a guarded assert in compact path verifying index monotonicity post-compaction. open revert if canary fails. ci-bot: image gh/onboard/proto-int4:tile-try-7 pushed to staging :white_check_mark:
sami_ml: I'll run tile-linear and deterministic seed run now and post rope diffs + goldset. if confirmed, i'll open PR titled "fix: tile-compaction index remap order for non-unit stride" with a unit test mapping expected->actual indices.
ugo_research: long-term: add end-to-end unit test that runs compact+remap on small synthetic kvs with stride>1 and asserts RoPE multipliers computed on remapped indices match baseline.
viktor_eval: agreed. thanks — please update this thread when runs finish.
